page.overview:
Who is Lord Sam Sinister?

Lord Sam Sinister, also known by many other names including Baron von Barron (or Baron von Baron), Sam Sinister (or Sam Sanister), Evil Eye, Mr. Hates, and Samuel von Barron, is the main villain from the Adventurers and Orient Expedition themes. Sinister competes with Johnny Thunder in all of the Adventurers sub-themes (except for the 1999 Jungle theme) as they search for ancient artifacts and treasures from around the world.

In Adventurers, Sam Sinister has a dark grey hook in place of his left hand. He has a monocle over his right eye, a large handlebar mustache (depicted as mutton chops in World Club Magazine Time Cruisers comics), and a scar on his left cheek. He generally wears a brick yellow khaki shirt, a black glove on his right hand, a pair of white epaulets, and either a white pith helmet or a grey or earth orange aviator helmet.

In LEGO Racers, his in-game model does not have epaulets, much like Captain Redbeard. In LEGO Racers 2, his epaulets and hook are missing from his model, leading him to be depicted with two normal hands. In the intro cutscene of LEGO Stunt Rally, his left hand is a regular black hand instead of a hook; his right hand is obscured, leaving it possible that his hand and hook were erroneously swapped.

In renders for LEGO Racers and Rocket Racers, Baron von Barron is portrayed with a mirrored face print that is missing his mouth, no epaulets, and a regular bright yellow hand instead of a black glove. This design also appears in at least one of the clips of the Rocket Racers queue video. However, other Rocket Racers clips depict von Barron's design matching his physical minifigure, albeit with a fully-modeled transparent monocle instead of a printed opaque one.
